task_summary: Consolidate all psoriasis arms into one reproducible repo on n013

steps.title: Map every artifact to arm + code lineage
steps.description: For all ~370 artifacts across the ~13 frames, pull lineage and classify each as (a) has recoverable generating code, (b) terminal output with partial provenance, or (c) raw input/download. Produce REPRODUCIBILITY_GAP.md grouping by arm.

steps.title: Diff repo contents vs artifact store
steps.description: For each arm, determine what is already committed in the n013 repo vs what exists only as artifacts, so consolidation only adds what is missing and never overwrites (additive rule).

steps.title: Verify skin-arm reproducibility
steps.description: Confirm meta-analysis, Scissor, theory-1, lncRNA scripts in code/ regenerate their key outputs; add any missing generating scripts recovered from lineage; write per-arm REPRODUCE notes.

steps.title: Organize docking/MD + isoforms
steps.description: Stage docking/MD artifacts (pdb, sdf, pdf, csv) and STAT3 isoform artifacts into results/docking_md/ and results/isoforms/ with a manifest; recover generating code where lineage has it, flag terminal-only outputs.

steps.title: Organize pathway/TF, presentation, genome-browser
steps.description: Stage pathway/TF-activity tables, presentation figures/pptx, and the genome-browser tool into labelled subdirs with manifests; note which are re-runnable.

steps.title: Write master README + arm map
steps.description: Author a top-level README mapping every arm to its scripts/inputs/outputs and pointing to per-arm REPRODUCE notes, PROJECT_AUDIT.md, and NARRATIVE_walkthrough.md. Reconcile CHECKPOINT/PLAN.

steps.title: Additive commit + push + verify
steps.description: Commit all additions to n013 repo (additive only, never overwrite existing files), push to GitHub, and verify 0 unpushed + working tree clean. Save the gap report + README as artifacts.

desired_outputs: A single reproducible repo (psoriasis-1-bulk on n013 + GitHub) with every arm organized under code/, data/, results/, figures/, docs/
Top-level README mapping each arm to its scripts, inputs, and outputs
Per-arm REPRODUCE notes documenting how each result regenerates (or why it can't)
A reproducibility gap report: which artifacts have recoverable generating code vs which are terminal outputs
environment.yml / renv manifests captured per arm's toolchain

feasibility.rationale: The skin arms (meta-analysis, Scissor, theory-1) already have code in the repo and are fully reproducible. The risk is in the older arms: docking/MD, isoforms, pathway, and presentation artifacts may be terminal outputs whose generating code was never saved to the repo and may not be fully recoverable from lineage — those become 'archived outputs with partial provenance,' not fully re-runnable pipelines. I'll audit recoverability first and be explicit per arm about what is re-runnable vs archival.
